messages:
Maia Brooks: Quick design review — trying a denser compare row + keyboard pin shortcut. Screenshot: https://figs.example.com/s/compact-compare-preview.png
Priya Nair: Nice — can you paste a11y contrast numbers? The new badge color looks low contrast on light mode.
Alex Rivera: Agree on contrast. Also worried condensed rows hide metric meaning. Maybe show tooltip on hover + inline abbreviation.
Maia Brooks: Thinking: show 3 cols collapsed: name | perf badge | pin. Expand aria-hidden details on focus. Toggle with `Space` when row focused.
Jon Chen: +1 to keyboard. Proposed shortcut: `K` to toggle pin for focused row. Could we stick to `Enter`/`Space` for screen readers?
Samir Patel: UX nit: microcopy for pin should be "Pinned version" not just "Pinned" — screens say it's ambiguous.
DesignBot: Accessibility check: perf-badge color #9A73FF fails WCAG AA small text. Suggest #7B4BFF or add outline.
Priya Nair: Also add `aria-label="Toggle pin for {model name} version {version}"` to the button.
Alex Rivera: For badge semantics — should the badge reflect latency or resource cost? PM wants latency for UX, infra wants cost. Can we show both? small tooltip with p50/p95 and token cost.
Maia Brooks: Proposal: primary badge = p95 latency rounded, secondary hover detail = tokens/sec and GPU-cost score. We'll mock copy.
Jon Chen: A/B test: control = current rows, variant = collapsed rows + `K` shortcut. Metrics: time-to-pin, keyboard activation rate, compare-to-launch conversion.
Samir Patel: Also keyboard focus order: name -> metrics -> pin -> actions. Ensure `Skip to compare` link works.
Priya Nair: Microcopy option for pin CTA: `Pin version (keeps this variant in compare)` longer but clearer.
Maia Brooks: Quick prototype done: https://figma.com/file/abc - please review before EOD. If ok, I'll open a small experiment ticket.
Alex Rivera: One more: screen reader announcement when pinned: `Model X v2 pinned for compare` with polite `aria-live`.
Jon Chen: Bumping: can we standardize badge color semantics doc? I'll draft a short PR to docs repo.
Maia Brooks: Thanks — action items: Priya contrast + aria labels, Alex tooltip content, Jon experiment metric + docs PR, Samir copy tweak. I'll file tickets.
Priya Nair: LGTM :+1:
Samir Patel: Thanks! :sparkles:
DesignBot: Created ticket #UI-3429 for collapsed rows A/B test.
Maia Brooks: Great, thanks team.
